Chain a fixed price series, returning NA instead of failing

Source: R/aggregate_activities.R
dot-fixed_prices_safe.Rd

Chain a fixed price series, returning NA instead of failing

Usage

.fixed_prices_safe(cp, pyp, time, ref_year, label = NULL)

Arguments

cp

A numeric vector of current price values.

pyp

A numeric vector of previous year's price values.

time

A vector of dates or years. One observation per year is required, but the years need not be sorted or consecutive.

ref_year

Numeric reference (base) year of the returned fixed price series. Must be present in time.

label

A label used in the warning message.
